name: Deployment notes
description: A plaintext note, not a key. Attaching it to a repository URI is the wrong-type error, since Diffusion takes only an SSH key or a token.
secret: The staging host reboots on Sundays. Sample data, not a secret.

name: Mirror key, no Conduit access
description: Conduit access is deliberately off. Attaching this to a repository URI works, since that needs only the PHID and the type, while anything that reads the secret is denied.

name: Observe key
description: An SSH key readable through Conduit: the credential a working `diffusion uri create --credential` uses.

name: Artifact registry login
description: A username and password pair. Sample data, so the password is not one.

name: Build agent token
description: An API token. Sample data, so the token is not one.
